change.title: Extract the aggregate one-click compensation phase owner
change.summary: Moves the existing aggregate Science cleanup, SSH cleanup, authority restore, prior-runtime restart, snapshot cleanup, diagnostic rendering, and typed recovery projection out of the general one-click module while preserving the sole cold failure funnel and all compensation behavior.

basis: run_cold_one_click retains the sole Ok commit and Err compensation dispatch after the transaction_result closure
compensate_one_click_failure and its typed step, environment, outcome, diagnostic, and recovery projection types are exclusively owned by cold/compensation.rs

the extracted body preserves the exact Science cleanup, SSH cleanup, authority restore, prior-runtime restart, snapshot cleanup, disposition update, trace finish, diagnostic rendering, and typed recovery order
OneClickJournalProgress restore expectations, complete-record CAS, locks, receipts, checkpoint order, DTOs, visible text, and history semantics remain unchanged
Rust AST and Python source-boundary tests verify the dedicated owner, sole cold failure call, typed outcome projection, and unchanged SSH/authority transaction boundaries

durable stepwise compensation progress or replay, prior-stop, authority capture, Gateway, managed Science launch, route, finalize, read-model, update provenance, artifact, installed/live, signing, and release changes remain excluded
